title: The U.S. added only 29,000 jobs in September as job market lacks spark
summary: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September as the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%. Job gains for July and August were revised down by a total of 60,000 jobs, extending a lackluster run for the job market.
author: Scott Horsley
